annotation.title_clean: Guidelines on Assessment of AI Reliability in the Field of Plant Safety, Second Edition
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on Assessment of AI Reliability in the Field of Plant Safety, Second Edition
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Liaison Council of Three Ministries on Disaster Prevention of Petroleum Complexes (METI; Fire and Disaster Management Agency; MHLW)
annotation.venue: Fire and Disaster Management Agency (FDMA), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese three-ministry guidelines (2nd ed., March 2021) for assessing machine-learning reliability in petroleum and chemical plant safety. They adapt AIST's Machine Learning Quality Management Guideline into quality-in-use, external and internal quality levels, with use-case examples. It is software-focused AI for plant monitoring, not robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three-tier quality hierarchy: quality in use, external quality, internal quality.
Risk avoidance levels 0, 0.1, 0.2, 1 and performance levels 0, 1, 2 determine the required internal quality.
Internal quality levels 1-3 set requirements for data, model and operation methods.
Applies AIST Machine Learning Quality Management Guideline and QA4AI guideline to plant safety.
Use cases include early-sign abnormality detection and equipment deterioration diagnosis.
